what: The letters of the long story text start almost transparent at .08, then each letter is tied to scroll and darkens to 1 from when its own center passes 90% of screen height until it reaches 55% (no curve, follows in a .2s linear step when the value changes). It is set by position, not by order, so the letters on one line darken together, and as a paragraph rises the lines below follow and spread. Scrolling back up fades them again

options.start: Screen height (ratio) where it starts to darken, default .9
options.end: Screen height at which it reaches full intensity (ratio), default .55
options.fade: Duration of following the value (sec), default .2

use:
Your story’s first line here
Your story’s second line here
note: Text in hidden panels (no offsetParent) is not measured, and 50ms after the page is pressed it is measured again — for when a panel hidden by a language switch becomes visible. Words are inline-block chunks so Korean keep-all line breaks never split in the middle of a word

from.where: index.html .ft-story p (brand story paragraph — original .storyFade span.fadeChar opacity calc(.08 + .92 × --reveal), --reveal runs while the character’s center goes from vh×.9 to vh×.55, transition opacity .2s linear)
